summary: Implemented the window-title feature; nothing was run, per instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, delegating to self.control(Control.title(title)), with the required docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased "Added" section with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (output assertion skipped under legacy Windows), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, mocked wrapper). Unverified: tests and mypy were not run. Nothing was committed.
